title: research-graph-synthesize Configuration
description: ADR-045 synthesize_answer: terminal LLM stage. Quote-back-validated synthesis grounded in upstream evidence. Drives the continuation rule.

loops_bucket.description: NATS KV bucket holding research-pipeline loops and trigger/completion keys

max_evidence_in_prompt.description: Cap on number of ExecutionOutput evidence items embedded in the synthesizer prompt. Top-N by Score; tighter caps keep prompts within small-model context windows. 0 means default (30)

max_response_tokens.description: Cap on LLM response tokens for the synthesis output

max_snippet_chars_in_prompt.description: Cap on per-evidence SnippetText characters rendered in the synthesizer prompt. 0 means default (480)

ports.description: Port configuration. synthesize_answer requires one nats input subscribing to component.synthesize_answer.>
